_about: Road distances to Trimbakeshwar, behind the distance hub and the two transport pages. status uses the same vocabulary as facts.json: verified needs verifiedBy + verifiedAt + a source an editor read; reported = published by the named sources but not yet measured by an editor; disputed = the sources disagree (every figure is shown); not_verified = no supporting source yet. Rows marked verified were measured by the site's editor on Google Maps; all other rows are reported, disputed or not verified.
method: Three rows (CBS, Nashik Road station, Ramkund) are Google Maps driving routes measured on 22 Nov 2026 at about 11:50 AM IST to Trimbakeshwar Jyotirling Mandir; times vary with traffic. Every other row is compiled from the published sources named in it and is not yet measured.

rows.origin: Nashik CBS (Central Bus Stand) / Old CBS
rows.cheapest: MSRTC bus from the CBS (reported; confirm the platform and timings with MSRTC)
rows.notes: The usual reference point for "Nashik to Trimbakeshwar". Google Maps showed routes of 29.3, 29.4 and 29.6 km, fastest 56 min. We have no separate figure for Old CBS; use this one as a guide.
